source.document: POMALYST (pomalidomide) capsules, for oral use. Full prescribing information. Celgene Corporation.
source.spl_version: not recorded; the downloaded file name begins 20250510 and the PDF creation date is 2025-05-12
source.storage: Kept on the platform owner's computer only; not committed.
source.extraction: AI-assisted from the PDF text layer (pdftotext); every value below is copied with the sentence it comes from. Independent review pending.

scope_of_use: Multiple myeloma (MM) only. Kaposi sarcoma (KS) values are recorded because the label pools MM and KS in some statements, not for use.

regimen.quote: The recommended dosage of POMALYST is 4 mg once daily orally with or without food on Days 1 through 21 of each 28-day cycle until disease progression.

auc_tau_ss_mm_4mg_ng_h_ml.population: MM, 4 mg daily, alone or with dexamethasone, steady state
auc_tau_ss_mm_4mg_ng_h_ml.quote: In patients with MM who received POMALYST 4 mg daily alone or in combination with dexamethasone, pomalidomide steady-state drug exposure was characterized by AUC (CV%) of 860 (37%) ng∙h/mL and Cmax (CV%) of 75 (32%) ng/mL.
auc_tau_ss_mm_4mg_ng_h_ml.note: The AUC interval is not stated; read as AUC over the 24 h dosing interval at steady state.

auc_ss_ks_5mg_ng_h_ml.population: KS, 5 mg daily, steady state; recorded, not used
auc_ss_ks_5mg_ng_h_ml.quote: In patients with Kaposi sarcoma (KS) who received POMALYST 5 mg daily, pomalidomide steady-state drug exposure was characterized by AUC of 462.3 ng∙h/mL (82%) and Cmax of 53.1 ng/mL (50%).

tmax_h.population: MM or KS, single oral doses
tmax_h.quote: Following administration of single oral doses of POMALYST, the maximum plasma concentration (Cmax) for pomalidomide occurs at 2 to 3 hours postdose in patients with MM or KS.

vd_f_l.quote: Pomalidomide has a mean apparent volume of distribution (Vd/F) between 62 and 138 L at steady state in patients with MM or KS.

cl_f_l_h.quote: Pomalidomide has a mean total body clearance (CL/F) of 7-10 L/h in patients with MM or KS.

half_life_h_patients.quote: Pomalidomide is eliminated with a median plasma half-life of 9.5 hours in healthy subjects and 7.5 hours in patients with MM or KS.

fraction_excreted_unchanged.quote: approximately 2% and 8% of the radiolabeled dose eliminated unchanged as pomalidomide in urine and feces.

protein_binding_percent.quote: Human plasma protein binding of pomalidomide ranges from 12% to 44% and is not concentration dependent.

linearity.note: The label does not state dose proportionality or time dependence. No statement of non-linear or time-dependent PK was found in sections 2, 8 or 12.

renal_moderate_or_severe_no_dialysis.quote: Pomalidomide pharmacokinetic parameters were not significantly affected in patients with moderate (30 mL/min ≤ CLcr< 60 mL/min) or severe (15 mL/min ≤ CLcr< 30 mL/min) renal impairment relative to patients with normal renal function (CLcr ≥ 60 mL/min).

renal_severe_requiring_dialysis.quote: Mean exposure (AUC) to pomalidomide increased by 38% in patients with severe renal impairment requiring dialysis (CLcr< 30 mL/min requiring dialysis) and 40% in patients with end stage renal disease (CLcr< 15 mL/min) on non-dialysis days.
renal_severe_requiring_dialysis.label_dose_modification: MM: 3 mg daily, taken after dialysis on dialysis days (section 2.7)

hepatic_child_pugh_a.quote: Following single dose administration, the AUC of pomalidomide increased 51%, 58%, and 72% in subjects with mild (Child-Pugh class A), moderate (Child-Pugh class B), and severe (Child-Pugh class C) hepatic impairment, respectively compared to subjects with normal liver function.

fluvoxamine_strong_cyp1a2_inhibitor.quote: Co-administration of fluvoxamine (a strong CYP1A2 inhibitor) with POMALYST increased mean [90% confidence interval] pomalidomide exposure by 125% [98% to 157%] compared to POMALYST alone in healthy subjects.

fluvoxamine_with_ketoconazole.quote: Co-administration of fluvoxamine in the presence of ketoconazole (a strong CYP3A4 and P-gp inhibitor) with POMALYST increased mean pomalidomide exposure by 146% [126% to 167%] compared to POMALYST administered alone in healthy subjects

ketoconazole_strong_cyp3a4_pgp_inhibitor.quote: Co-administration of ketoconazole (a strong CYP3A4 and P-gp inhibitor) in 16 healthy male subjects increased AUC of pomalidomide by 19% compared to POMALYST administered alone.

carbamazepine_strong_cyp3a4_inducer.quote: Co-administration of carbamazepine to 16 healthy male subjects decreased AUC of pomalidomide by 20% with a 90% confidence interval [13% to 27%] compared to when pomalidomide was administered alone.

smoking_25_per_day.study_population: healthy male subjects, single 4 mg dose (14 smokers vs 13 non-smokers)
smoking_25_per_day.quote: In 14 healthy male subjects who smoked 25 cigarettes per day for a total of 10 days, after single oral dose of 4 mg POMALYST, Cmax of pomalidomide increased 14% while AUC of pomalidomide decreased 32%, compared to that in 13 healthy male subjects who were non-smokers.

high_fat_meal.quote: delays the Tmax by 2.5 hours, decreased mean plasma Cmax and AUC in healthy subjects by about 27% and 8%, respectively.

not_stated: The interval of the steady-state AUC (read as 0-24 h).
Absolute bioavailability; all clearance and volume values are apparent (divided by F).
Absorption rate constant and lag time.
Whether the MM-only exposure and the pooled MM-or-KS clearance and volume come from the same studies.
